s1-door: Vertical portrait photograph taken from standing eye level looking straight down a dim country-house corridor at night toward a heavy dark panelled door at its end, low lamplit ceiling at the top of frame, bare floorboards at the bottom. The door is shut, warm oil-lamp light from a wall sconce, deep shadows. No people. Photorealistic, tense, quiet.
s2-house: Vertical portrait photograph taken from standing eye level looking straight at a long grey two-storey Irish country house standing alone above a rocky Atlantic shore, heavy storm sky at the top of frame, dark seaweed rocks and grey water at the bottom, bare Connemara mountains behind. One window lit. No people. Photorealistic, bleak, cold.
s3-corridor: Vertical portrait night photograph taken from standing eye level looking straight along an empty upstairs corridor of an old Irish country house, low ceiling at the top of frame, bare worn floorboards at the bottom. A row of closed doors on one side, moonlight from a small end window, a single oil lamp burning low. No people. Photorealistic, silent, uneasy.
s4a-room: Vertical portrait night photograph taken from standing eye level looking straight across a small nineteen-seventeen Irish country-house sitting room at night, lit by one candle on a round wooden table, dark panelled walls, a turf fire burned low in a small grate, heavy curtains closed, one dark corner beside a tall dresser. The corner is empty. No people. Photorealistic, hushed, heavy.
s4b-room-boy: Vertical portrait night photograph taken from standing eye level looking straight across a small nineteen-seventeen Irish country-house sitting room at night, lit by one candle on a round wooden table, dark panelled walls, a turf fire burned low in a small grate, heavy curtains closed, one dark corner beside a tall dresser. Deep in that dark corner, almost swallowed by the shadow, the barely-visible shape of a boy of about fourteen in old-fashioned nightclothes: his face only a faint pale smudge in the darkness, his large dark eyes two dim points catching the candlelight, his outline dissolving into the shadow around him. He is almost not there. No other people. Photorealistic, terrifying, subtle.
s5-fire: Vertical portrait night photograph taken from standing eye level looking straight across dark water at a long two-storey Irish country house burning at night in the distance, black sky and rising smoke at the top of frame, the fire's orange reflection on the water at the bottom. Flames in the windows. No people. Photorealistic.
s6-hotel: Vertical portrait night photograph taken from standing eye level looking straight at a neat present-day hotel bedroom at night in an old Irish country house, white ceiling at the top of frame, carpeted floor at the bottom. A made bed with a warm bedside lamp on, heavy old walls and a panelled door standing slightly ajar onto a dark corridor. No people. Photorealistic, calm with something wrong.
